---
title: "LaTeX in documents"
tex-packages: [pgfplots]
---

Shared macros: $\E[X] \in \R$, $\argmax_\theta \norm{x - \theta}$,
$\dv{f}{x}$, $\abs{z}$.

## Raw LaTeX blocks

Drawings are native in the PDF and SVG images in HTML and EPUB.

::: {#fig-tikz}
```{=latex}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[->] (0,0) -- (2,0) node[right] {$x$};
  \draw[->] (0,0) -- (0,1.5) node[above] {$y$};
  \draw[accent, thick] (0,0) .. controls (1,1.5) .. (2,1);
\end{tikzpicture}
```

A TikZ figure.
:::

```{=latex}
\begin{tabular}{lrr}
  \toprule
  & $\alpha$ & $\beta$ \\
  \midrule
  run 1 & 0.12 & $-3.4$ \\
  run 2 & 0.50 & $1.0$ \\
  \bottomrule
\end{tabular}
```

```{=latex}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[width=6cm, height=4cm, xlabel={$t$}]
    \addplot[domain=0:6, samples=60, accent] {sin(deg(x))};
  \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
```

A displayed formula drawn by LaTeX, with no drawing environment:

```{=latex}
$\displaystyle \oint_{\partial S} \mathbf{B}\cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{l} = \mu_0 I$
```

Layout commands draw nothing, so HTML leaves them out:

```{=latex}
\vspace{1em}
```

```{=latex}
\newcommand{\onlyhere}{x}
```

```{=latex}
\newpage
```

A block that fails to compile gives a warning and is left out of HTML
(kept out of the PDF, where it would stop the build):

::: {.content-visible unless-format="pdf"}
```{=latex}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw (0,0) -- (1,1)
\end{tikzpicture}
```
:::

## Results and callouts

::: {#def-thing}
## A definition
Some text with $\vb{v} \in \R^3$.
:::

::: {#thm-thing}
## A theorem
By @def-thing, the result holds.
:::

::: {.proof}
Trivial.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
A note callout.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## With a title
A warning callout.
:::

See @fig-tikz and @thm-thing.
